column1: # Guitar Rig 6 "Phaser Nine" (NI::DSP::PhaserMXR), 48 kHz unless noted. Notch tracks from a periodic flat-spectrum probe.
# Setup (once):  cd $RE_STATE/work/phaser/bb ; export W=$RE_STATE/work/phaser   (W/tools holds the same files as evidence/tools)
#   python3 evidence/tools/ptrack.py gen probe12.wav --secs 12   (probe20: --secs 20, probe40: --secs 40, probe8_1024: --secs 8 --period 1024)
#   python3 grstate.py gr6_default.aupreset comp_Phaser_Nine.xml st_<tag>.aupreset n=4 c=0.4217 r=0.5 e=0.5 p=0.5 x=0.5 o=0.5 i=0 s=0 <overrides>
#   python3 ptrack.py track <probe> out_<tag>.wav > trk_<tag>.tsv ; python3 ptrack.py summary trk_<tag>.tsv --n 2
# Parameter ids: p Rate, c Color, r Depth, e Frequency, n Notches(stages), x Dry/Wet, o Rotate. peak_db includes the model's 5.40 dB make-up gain.
# period_s is an autocorrelation estimate; with fewer than three periods in the take it reads about 2.5 % short.
d000c000 p=0.1 r=0.0 c=0 (static, feedback off)
